name: Algebraic Sum Obfuscation
description: Replaces the binary exact-cover mask and bitwise AND operation with a mathematically equivalent subset-sum condition in base 100. Because base 100 is strictly larger than the maximum number of terms in the sum (3k <= 66), carries are impossible, making the sum condition exactly identical to the exact-cover condition. This hides the independent column structure, preventing models from parsing it as 3-Dimensional Matching unless they deduce the no-carry property.
